subject.title: Telegram /reasoning stream can leave replies stuck after send_attempt_started and chat.history burst

question: Should this issue stay as the distinct Telegram `/reasoning stream` plus `chat.history` recovery track, or be folded into the broader ambiguous-send delivery recovery work?
rationale: Source evidence shows a shared ambiguous-send recovery gap, but this report adds a reasoning-preview trigger and Control UI history pressure that the related issues and PRs do not fully own.

options.title: Track Distinct Reasoning/History Work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the place to prove Telegram reasoning preview/final delivery and decide whether `chat.history` needs backpressure or debouncing.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Recovery
options.body: Treat the reasoning and history details as symptoms and track the remaining recovery behavior through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91456 and the outbound recovery PRs.

options.title: Split UI History Separately
options.body: Use this issue for Telegram ambiguous-send recovery and create or select a separate Control UI item if the history burst is confirmed as an independent bug.

recommendation.title: Track Distinct Reasoning/History Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the place to prove Telegram reasoning preview/final delivery and decide whether `chat.history` needs backpressure or debouncing.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses core outbound queue semantics, operator behavior, and channel delivery safety where recent history points to this owner as a central reviewer/contributor.
